texts.value: Associated to surface IgM-receptor; may be involved in signal transduction. Involved in regulation of the catalytic activity of the phosphatases PP2A, PP4 and PP6 by protecting their partially folded catalytic subunits from degradative polyubiquitination until they associate with regulatory subunits
Interacts with partially folded PPP2CA, but not with the fully active protein. Interacts with PPP2CB, and with PP4 and PP6. Interacts with MID1 and MID2. Interacts with ubiquitin

disease.description: An intellectual disability syndrome characterized by agenesis of the corpus callosum, coloboma of the iris and optic nerve, severe retrognathia, and intellectual deficit. Intellectual disability is defined by significantly below average general intellectual functioning associated with impairments in adaptive behavior and manifested during the developmental period.
